postAttachCommand: echo 'Initialize catkin: source /opt/ros/noetic/setup.bash && cd /catkin_ws/src && catkin_init_workspace && cd /catkin_ws && catkin_make'
postCreateCommand: echo 'source /opt/ros/noetic/setup.bash' >> ~/.bashrc && echo 'source /catkin_ws/devel/setup.bash' >> ~/.bashrc && echo 'export DISPLAY=:1' >> ~/.bashrc && echo 'export QT_X11_NO_MITSHM=1' >> ~/.bashrc
